chunks: And ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
“If you wash the head of the deceased and his beard with khitmi, there is no issue.”

key_terms.بِالْخِطْمِيِّ: with khitmi, a cleansing plant substance
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to wash the head and beard of the deceased with khitmi?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the washing of the deceased. It states that using khitmi to wash the head and beard of the deceased is permissible and carries no objection.
